message.content:
Mr Hezekiah had 20 trucks. Each truck carried 20 tons of fertiliser. 

Two hours after departure, 25% of the trucks (a quarter of 20) had mechanical failures. 

The number of trucks that could not deliver is $ \frac{1}{4} \times 20 = 5 $.

The total amount of fertiliser that reached the farmers is:

$$
(20 - 5) \times 20 = 15 \times 20 = 300
$$

FINAL_ANSWER: 300
